usedFor: Missive holds your team’s conversations and contacts, and Airtable keeps the records when “New Contact” runs “Create Record”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Missive, then “Create Record” in Airtable
bestTemplate.why: Every contact Missive creates becomes a row in your base, ready for views and follow-up.

watchOut: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable also fires on edits, so pair it with “Update Contact” to avoid duplicate contacts.
